dedupe_keys.name: city of tacoma capital projects layer capital improvement and facilities plans

description: Tacoma's Capital Projects layer maps the general areas of the city's capital projects with their project data, maintained under section 10.22.160 of the Tacoma Municipal Code, which lets Public Works keep a 'Capital Improvement Projects' GIS layer on which utilities and communications operators must also identify and update their projects. It held 274 project polygons when read, with project name, website, links to the six-year transportation plan, the Capital Facilities Program and other programmes, lead department and contact, partners, project type, description, council districts, neighbourhood and business districts, current phase, construction start and end, total estimated cost, confirmed funds, location description, rationale, phase notes and status. Two apps draw on it: the Capital Improvement Plan app for transportation, wastewater, city facility and other projects under way, and the Capital Facilities Plan app for the six-year list of city facility projects presented to the City Council. Coverage: City of Tacoma, Washington. Access: free feature service. Licence: city terms. Caveats: polygons show general project areas, not exact footprints. Simulation uses: planned facility and street works for city infrastructure scenarios and coordination of works. Related records: the NYC Capital Projects Dashboard.
